messages:
deploy-bot: Kickoff: staged rollout v2.3.1 -> 7% canary (rollout_id=rollout_3300100000). Change window: 2026-03-22 01:00-02:00 UTC. Auto-advance checks every 5m. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.1.

nina: Noticing an odd uptick in 5xxs from ap-east at ~01:04. Small sample but consistent traces show GPU worker OOMs on large-batch decode.

kai: Can you paste logs?

nina: linked: https://short.link/logs/ap-east-oom-330010. Excerpt: 
```
2026-03-22T01:04:12Z worker-gpu-2: cudaMemcpy failed: out of memory
2026-03-22T01:04:13Z runtime: aborting decode for request req-xx: OOM
```

matt: If this is region-specific, I'd prefer region pin instead of global rollback. Options: 1) regional override ap-east -> v2.2.11 and hold rollout, 2) reduce canary to 1% and continue investigating, 3) immediate full rollback. Vote?

ops-bot: Suggested commands:
```
# pin ap-east back to stable
deployctl rollout region-override --id rollout_3300100000 --region ap-east --target v2.2.11
# hold rollout to prevent auto-advance
deployctl rollout hold --id rollout_3300100000
# set global canary to 1% while we triage
deployctl rollout set-traffic --id rollout_3300100000 --global-canary 1%
```

oncall-sre: I'll apply ap-east override + hold. Also enabling node-level memory limits and temporarily turning off large-batch auto-unroll on canary nodes. ETA 3m.

deploy-bot: Applied: ap-east -> v2.2.11 (100% ap-east), rollout set to HELD, global canary lowered to 1%. Links: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/rollout_3300100000

kai: After the override, 5xxs in ap-east dropped to baseline. Remaining canaries look stable. I'll run a targeted GC and reduce batch window on canary GPU pods, then re-evaluate after 10m.

nina: I'll open a short PR to add a canary-only conservative batch config and add a note in release notes about the GPU memory behavior.

matt: Consensus: region-override + hold, then conservative canary config. Reactions: :thumbsup: nina, kai, matt. If issues recur in other regions we escalate to rollback.

oncall-sre: Incident classified as minor; follow-up: postmortem to capture batch sizing guidance and a runtime guard to auto-fail decode before OOM. Keeping thread pinned.
